meta.title: CPQ Software — Configure, Price, Quote · Agree Technologies
meta.description: ATSuite CPQ helps B2B SaaS teams configure, price, and quote complex deals with precision — guided selling, approvals, and accurate pricing at scale.

page-hero.h1-quote-with-speed-confi: Quote with speed, configure with precision.
page-hero.p-an-automated-cpq-that: Configure complex products, apply customer-specific pricing and route exceptions for approval — then carry the approved commercial terms directly into subscription and billing.
page-hero.alt-screenshot: An ATSuite quote: the opportunity stage bar from New through to Won, above an approved offer showing contract length, one-time and recurring price and profit, and a configured product line with its group, SKU, subscription type and quantity.
page-hero.div-shot-caption: ATSuite · Quote and approval — approved before it reaches the customer · illustrative data

split-section.p-a-multilingual-product: A multilingual product catalogue keeps your offerings accessible across European and global markets.
